meta.name: Aircord Observability Trust Memory
meta.description: A restrained technical dashboard DNA synthesized from Linear, MotherDuck, and Datadog Cloud Observability, adapted for an inspectable air-quality trust-memory proof surface.

source_references.name: Linear homepage
source_references.observed_patterns: Premium product hierarchy, generous whitespace, precise typography, product UI as evidence, and calm high-contrast surfaces.

source_references.name: MotherDuck homepage
source_references.observed_patterns: Approachable infrastructure storytelling, technical concepts made legible, natural-language-to-SQL framing, and product sections organized as a data narrative.

source_references.name: Datadog Cloud Observability
source_references.observed_patterns: Single-pane observability language, status-led cards, dashboards, metrics/logs/traces as connected evidence, and operational credibility.

secondary.role: graphite surfaces and strong secondary text

accent.role: trusted/live signal, links, and decision emphasis

neutral.usage: Cool neutral scale for page canvas, cards, dividers, metadata, body copy, and ink.

color.contrast_strategy: Dark ink on a cool white canvas with high-contrast data values, thin cool dividers, and accent color reserved for state and proof.

typography.font_style_notes: Neutral grotesk sans for product clarity, with compact monospace for identifiers, timestamps, formulas, and source evidence.

spacing.section_rhythm: Tight internal card rhythm with generous section breaks and a deliberate pause around the primary memory decision.

layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid with asymmetric hero emphasis

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px cool-gray borders; stronger accent border only for the primary decision and evidence callouts

elevation.depth_cues: Mostly borders and surface contrast, with low-opacity shadows only where a card needs lift.

iconography.preferred_set: Lucide-style outline icons or inline SVG equivalents

motion.entrance_pattern: subtle fade and 8px upward settle for primary sections

components.button_style: compact dark-ink primary buttons and text links with clear focus rings
components.input_style: white inputs with 1px cool-gray border and crisp focus accent
components.card_style: white evidence cards on a cool-gray canvas, thin border, tight label/value rhythm
components.navigation_pattern: quiet top utility bar with product mark, data source, and section anchors
components.modal_style: not needed for the single-page proof surface; use inline disclosure instead
components.list_style: dense evidence rows with timestamp, actor, state chip, and monospace identifier
components.component_notes: The page should read as one connected investigation: headline claim, decision, evidence, audit, vector, backtest, and MCP proof.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A control room for one remembered decision, where every number has a source trail.
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary cloud software with editorial restraint

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous around the hero and primary decision, compact inside evidence cards
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Heavy at the headline and memory decision, distributed through evidence rails and proof cards.
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero decision followed by progressive evidence reveal
visual_language.texture_usage: none beyond faint grid/rule structure and surface contrast

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast plus color weight and spatial isolation
composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom investigation with left-to-right evidence comparisons
composition.grouping_strategy: semantic bands: decision, sensor/reference, audit, validation, access
composition.negative_space_role: creates confidence and separates conclusion from supporting evidence

imagery.photo_treatment: none; product proof uses live data instead of photography
imagery.illustration_style: minimal line diagrams only when needed
imagery.graphic_elements: small signal bars, rules, dots, and evidence connectors
imagery.pattern_usage: very faint technical grid in hero background only

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: subtle border and shadow lift on interactive cards/links
interaction_feel.loading_style: content-first skeleton or compact status line; never an infinite blank state

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: subtle suggestion and direct evidence links
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain what is missing, identify the source, and offer the exact next command

overview.fallback_strategy: disable nonessential motion under prefers-reduced-motion and preserve static data layout

background_effects.description: No animated background; use a static cool-gray canvas and a faint grid rule in the hero.

particle_systems.description: No particles; evidence should remain legible.

3d_elements.description: No 3D elements; the product is an inspectable data surface.

cursor_effects.description: Use the system cursor for dependable dashboard interaction.

image_effects.description: No image layer is required for the proof surface.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Use only a faint static grid, restrained section entrance, focus-ring transitions, and state-color changes. The data and audit trail are the visual interest; avoid decorative motion and gradient effects.
